issues.description: The supplied Stata files replace required author-specific store, brand, user, employee and survey corrections with redaction comments or placeholder lists. This includes the undefined `stores` expansion in 4.1; literal `XXX` brand loops; the 5.1 loop that writes mpr_coordinates_XXXX but later reads mpr_coordinates_XXX; and redacted map/filter blocks in 1.1, 2.1, 3.1, 3.2, 6.1, 7.1, 7.2 and 7.3. These values and rules cannot be reconstructed from the package, so the full preparation closure remains incomplete.

1.1 saves poster_clean731 in C. Master Dataset/input and exports an Excel workbook, but 1.2 reads B. Data Preparation/01. Customer Panel Data/input/poster_clean731_Final_Stata.dta with additional hand-coded poster fields. No supplied script creates that exact file or documents the manual conversion/merge-key checks. The two files cannot be treated as aliases without author confirmation.

1.2 changes to the customer-panel output directory, then changes to programs/logs to open the log and never changes back. Its relative Poster_AppRatings, temp1 and CustomerPanel_Dataset saves therefore land under programs/logs; 7.3 expects CustomerPanel_Dataset under the customer-panel output directory.

7.2 changes into C. Master Dataset/input and saves master_survey plus both median files by relative name without changing directory. 7.1 and 7.3 read those files from C. Master Dataset/output. The actual producer-consumer order is 7.2 before 7.1, despite the 7.1/7.2 filename order.

The scripts hard-code a Windows T: project root for reads, writes and logs, while the available Stata 18 runtime is on this Linux environment. A consistent project-root mapping or host-specific path adaptation is needed across every affected producer and consumer; changing only one call would leave later handoffs unresolved.

The current online appendix reports robustness variants for winsorized sales, zero-sales rows, alternate attendance cleaning, November inclusion and fixed effects. The supplied scripts include the sales/attendance filters, create sales_w, and expose a November switch, but do not implement a complete set of those alternative runs or a separate branch that preserves the baseline. Request the author’s companion code or precise variant recipe; do not infer the missing sample rules.

The current online appendix reports Figure OA-7.1 from 100 simulations, but none of the 12 supplied Stata programs contains a power-simulation routine. The appendix provides variance constants and a literature-based creativity variance; the author must confirm whether these values fully replace the historical-data variance-estimation step and provide the simulator, scenario grid, random-seed convention and figure-generation instructions. Do not require raw 2015 data unless the intended replay re-estimates those variance components.

actions.description: Obtain the author/company-approved source and survey inputs required by the full pipeline, in the documented formats and at the listed paths; verify schemas, periods, identifiers and coverage with the authors.
steps: Request an approved author/company handoff or authorized access route for every file named in the linked requirements; the archive explicitly omits proprietary input/output data.
For each workbook, confirm worksheet names and imported Stata field names; for store-specific sales CSVs, obtain the full store list and matching files without guessing redacted identifiers.
Confirm panel coverage, keys and date definitions against the stated periods, including the treatment indicator at both required input paths.
Do not reconstruct or substitute synthetic company, survey, customer-panel or activity data.
validation: After an approved route is available, use bounded metadata/readability checks for each input and verify required fields, IDs, dates and sheet names before running its producer.
Confirm sales and attendance cover May 2016–January 2017 and verify the stated periods for survey and poster inputs.

validation: After the authors identify the route, check required columns and poster-key uniqueness with a bounded metadata/readability probe; confirm the produced CustomerPanel_Dataset path matches 7.3.

review_notes: The initial and expanded evidence/requirements checkpoints are retained. The first attempt to append issue/action/dependency sections stopped before writing because a grouped dependency coverage check raised KeyError: 'dependency_id'; the corrected build uses an explicit grouped-ID conditional.
The full workflow has 12 Stata entry files and no supplied analysis-ready dataset route; no analysis_only scope is justified.
OA5 pairwise-correlation variables are computed in 8.0 and written to its text log; the appendix table layout may require manual assembly.

OA6 does not include all reported alternative cleaning runs. OA7 reports variance constants; historical 2015 data are not treated as a separate live requirement unless variance re-estimation is confirmed as part of the intended replay.

Catalog lookups for company retail sales, promoter attendance, panel ratings and store-coordinate sources returned no candidate records; this does not establish that no local or licensed route exists.
All software checks used self-written Stata which/version probes only; no author program or dataset was run.
